description:
`dev/scripts/verify-campaign-log.py` resolves an omitted exploratory `pilot_pairs` to the receipt's `confirmatory_pairs`, so it rejects a correct exploratory campaign whose plan leaves `pilot_pairs` null.

## Background

The protocol (`dev/active/f547c394/protocol.md`, acceptance section) states that an omitted exploratory `pilot_pairs` selects the frozen `pilot_min_pairs` and that a confirmation uses `confirmatory_pairs`. The shared checker's declared-pairs rule (`cell["pilot_pairs"] or confirmatory`) applies the confirmatory count to every omitted value. The logical-buffer harness's `logical-campaign plan` writes `pilot_pairs: null` for its exploratory cells, so the three accepted 18a87159 pilots (17, 17 and 6 cells at six pairs) fail the shared check although their receipts and the acceptance tool accept them; other families' plans write the number and never reach the branch. The receipt's `settings` carries `pilot_min_pairs`, `pilot_max_pairs` and `confirmatory_pairs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The checker resolves an omitted `pilot_pairs` by the cell's role exactly as the protocol states: an exploratory cell to the receipt's `pilot_min_pairs`, a confirmatory cell to `confirmatory_pairs`, reading the role from the receipt's addendum snapshot or the plan's declared role rather than assuming it.
- [hard] REQ-02: `dev/scripts/verify-campaign-log.test.sh` covers an exploratory plan with a null `pilot_pairs` at `pilot_min_pairs`, a confirmatory plan, and an exploratory plan whose log ran at the wrong count, and the three committed 18a87159 pilot campaigns under `dev/bench_results/2037941f/` pass the checker unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every launcher that calls the checker (ad2a6a58, 4c1e441f and any other caller found by search) keeps passing on its committed campaigns, and no committed evidence file changes.

## Notes

Found by the 18a87159 post-window round (session 22). The checker is shared campaign tooling under the epic's provenance freeze: no protocol, schema or receipt version changes. Follow `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md`.
title: Resolve an omitted exploratory pilot_pairs to pilot_min_pairs in the log checker
